Hundreds are dead or missing. Amid the destruction, one multi-story house with reinforced concrete columns remained standing while neighboring structures were completely swept away.  Residents watched from the balcony as the torrent raged. The incident highlights Nepal's extreme vulnerability to climate-driven disasters and the critical role of stronger building codes and structural engineering in saving lives. Something Was Found in Flooded Nepal That Could Not Have Been There When the floods swept through Nepal, the water did not just cause damage, it dragged impossible things into the light. Ambrose Wild walks you through ten of them, from a sea fossil stranded high in the mountains and a boulder no ordinary river should be able to move, to cliff tombs no living person can climb and a capital built on the floor of a vanished lake. For each one you get the real, measurable explanation instead of a mystery, including how ocean floors were lifted into the sky and how highlanders inherited a survival gene from a lost human species. By the end, you see why none of it is a miracle, just the strange scale of the Himalaya. #Nepal #Himalaya #Geology #Archaeology #AncientMysteries
